rationale: S-0022-03 proposes a per-dendrite E-I parameter sweep on the t0022 testbed to map the DSI response surface. The from-scratch minimal DSGC substrate now serves as the canonical platform for E-I sweeps (t0054 has begun the gNMDA dimension; t0057 will add the tonic-GABA dimension). The t0022 testbed lineage has been de-emphasised since brainstorm 9. The 3-D E-I sweep idea is still useful but should be re-formulated against the from-scratch substrate. Reprioritising from high to medium.
